fireside.speaker: Sam
fireside.text: "Stone. We need 39 more for the palisade footings. Creek beds, hillsides — pry it loose."

fireside.speaker: Benoit

fireside.speaker: Wanjiru
fireside.text: "Stone. We need 2 more for the palisade footings. Creek beds, hillsides — pry it loose."

fireside.speaker: Willie
fireside.text: "Did you see their faces? Too many angles. I keep wondering what they want from us."

fireside.speaker: Wanjiru
fireside.text: "It waits. We wait. Somebody should check the snares — the table doesn't fill the pantry."

fireside.speaker: Devon
fireside.text: "Nobody's sleeping. The sky is waiting and nobody knows what to do with their hands."

fireside.speaker: Benoit
fireside.text: "It eats while we deliberate. The Herald feeds on our stores and we're supposed to just... wait?"

fireside.speaker: Devon
fireside.text: "The table's set. The ring of pale light — it's just sitting there. Waiting on them. What do you think they'll tell it?"

tableLines.line: "Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Tariq.
You see smoke on the horizon. The Red Table — 2 people, 30 days in. foragers, by the look of it. They know 5 plants — 5 new to you. They've been here the whole time.
🧳 A traveler says Emberhold burned — the whole fire, gone. (Wrong. It split: the eaters walked. The Red Table is the new fire.)

Fresh-cut stems on the southeast ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (The Red Table's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Sam speaks at Stonebridge's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.

The southeast ground is thinning faster than your crews alone could strip it. The Red Table isn't slowing down — their foragers are on your turf most days now. Their speaker would probably want words. (Talk about the shared ground at their fire.)
The Red Table's speaker sent a runner: the southeast ground feeds both villages or neither. They want to talk — properly, at their fire. Ignoring this is also an answer.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)

🌙 Raid — The Red Table came in the night from the southeast. They carried off ~1400 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
